description: Fetch labelled time series from any Swiss National Bank data-portal cube: each series has its dimension labels, unit, scale and the most recent values (trimmed to values_per_series). Optional date range (YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD matching the cube frequency) and dimension_selection from get_snb_cube_dimensions, e.g. {"D0":["M0"],"D1":["EUR1","USD1"]}. Examples: cube_id='zimoma' (money market rates incl. SARON), cube_id='devkum', from_date='2024-01'.

cube_id.description: SNB cube id, e.g. 'devkum' (monthly FX), 'zimoma' (money market rates); see list_snb_datasets

language.description: Label language: en or de (default en)

to_date.description: End date, same format as from_date

values_per_series.description: Most recent observations kept per series (default 24; trimmed further if the output would exceed the 50 KB response cap)

name: get_snb_data
title: SNB cube time series
